learned: Twelve decisions: core generic clear scope, six reusable typed handles and TS-owned meanings; exact identities including undefined, re-created projections; refresh success boundary; clear-before-await separated from the newly joined release timing/rejection. Files-only input and composition vs specified inheritance are unexplained, as is parity reconciliation. Ten added cases and five retained old cases, controlled-vs-concrete cleanup and absence of terminal gate/cancellation are explicit.
descent: Linear lower mechanisms keep clear-before-await rationale distinct from why completion now propagates. Read the explanation, not its author runbook or execution record.
limits: Published PR explanation only; no independently rerun probe.
